title: Demand · NREL OEDI 8562 · county
description: Highest hourly electricity demand of each county in 2023, in MW, from the modeled county demand profiles of OEDI submission 8562 (National Laboratory of the Rockies, formerly NREL). Alaska and Hawaii are not covered and have empty values.

coverage.geography: Contiguous United States and the District of Columbia
known_gaps: Alaska and Hawaii are not covered.
County demand is modeled, not metered: in this dataset, retail sales reported by utilities are totaled by state and allocated to counties by each county's share of the state population.

Because sales are spread by population, a large load that does not follow population, such as a data center campus in a county with few residents, is spread across its state rather than placed in its county.

verification.method: The yearly maximum of the hourly profile of each county is computed by script from the source table. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 3,144 USA ADM2 units of the boundaries release; 3,109 are covered and 35 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.
